lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Did you make it to the hot springs all right?
We did, and we're proceeding with the mission.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: How are things progressing? Are there any resources that we can use?
There are no issues with the hot springs. And we've found a lot of minerals and other precious rocks.
We're also planning on taking some soil samples which could home to plenty of microorganisms.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Those will be a boon to our research.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Things are going better than I expected.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I thought it would take longer.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Once you're done with your preliminary investigation, you can enjoy a few days of R&R.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: It would be a shame if we forced you to return right away,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: what with it being Christmas and all.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Be careful handling those samples. We'll need them fully intact for our research.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: In the meantime, enjoy your time out there.
